Task 1 execution record (140.001-T).

R1 GATE (Step 2, blocking): inspected backlogit docs migrate --apply output on a real named file before any corpus-wide write. Observed source value = the file's own repo-relative path (self-referential). This is truthful, non-fabricated provenance, so the gate does not block on fabrication grounds.

CRITICAL DISCOVERY (would have failed AC3): direct probe of backlogit docs migrate --apply --yes --path <the AC3 spot-check file> (applied to the real file, diffed, then immediately git checkout -- reverted) showed the tool does NOT purely add source/doc_type. It RESTRUCTURES every pre-existing custom frontmatter key (problem_type, category, root_cause, tags, shipment, task, date) out of top-level position into a new nested docline: block, reformats date (2026-08-21 -> 2026-08-21T00:00:00Z), reformats tags (flow-list -> block-list), and writes an EMPTY title/description. This provably violates AC3 for the exact file AC3 names, and the empty title also fails the title required-field lint rule (see below), so blind --apply would have failed AC1/AC3/AC7 simultaneously.

RESOLUTION: implemented an additive-only equivalent (no re-serialization of existing lines; new keys inserted immediately before the closing --- of each file's frontmatter block, or a new block prepended for the 4 no-frontmatter files) reaching the SAME target values (source = self-path, doc_type = learning per backlogit docs scope path_map) without using the tool's --apply writer. Mechanically verified via git diff -U0 that every one of the 73 changed files has old_count == 0 on every hunk (pure insertion only) -- proves AC2 and AC3 simultaneously, not merely asserted.

RESIDUAL FIELD CLASS (Amendment C1): backlogit docs lint --path docs/compound (the actual binding predicate; Stage's baseline only ran docs migrate --dry-run + docs scope, never docs lint) reported a THIRD required-field class beyond source/doc_type: title, missing/empty on 32 files (28 with existing frontmatter + all 4 no-frontmatter files). Mechanically derivable from each file's own first H1 heading (verified: all 32 have a usable H1) -- FIXED WITHIN TASK 1, not deferred.

Four no-frontmatter files (matches plan C2 list exactly, all HAND-AUTHORED with title/source/doc_type):
- docs/compound/2026-08-07-copilot-review-fix-introduces-new-filter-bug.md
- docs/compound/2026-08-15-checksum-drift-fix-correctly-surfaces-preexisting-self-hosted-customization.md
- docs/compound/2026-08-15-never-serialize-raw-operator-content-into-json-reports.md
- docs/compound/2026-08-15-torn-archive-log-entry-without-file-mutation-must-not-be-committed.md

AC4 (idempotence): backlogit docs migrate --path docs/compound --dry-run will perpetually propose its own nested-docline restructuring regardless of lint validity (fixed output shape, not lint-driven), so it cannot serve as the idempotence oracle once corpus-wide restructuring is deliberately not applied. Substituted an equivalent, stronger idempotence proof: (a) backlogit docs lint --path docs/compound reports 0 violations post-fix, and (b) re-scanning the corpus with the same additive-check logic finds zero files still missing source/doc_type/title.

Test-first: tests/test_docs_compound_frontmatter_contract.py added; confirmed RED (72 missing source, 73 missing doc_type -- exact match to Stage baseline) via git stash of docs/compound changes, then GREEN after stash pop restored the fix. Canonical unittest suite (PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests): Ran 1704 tests, 5 failures/errors -- exact match to the 5 known pre-existing Windows-local failures tracked under E8158860. No new failures introduced.

AC1-AC7 satisfied. Deviation from literal Step 4 CLI invocation will be recorded as a compound learning at post-merge closure.
